items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: She was in the, she was in that bunch with Ann Cook and him.

ctx.x: Uh, she was tough, I tell you that.

Now we had, we had a woman, we had a woman from her, did you hear anything about Lessie? A woman called Lessie, was from up there? No, no. She was in the, she was in that bunch with Ann Cook and him. Yeah. She killed the woman on Gravy between, between Franklin and Saratoga. Yeah?
